# Keyboard key (`kbd`)

Key caps and shortcut chords (Ctrl + K).

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createKbd` (types in `dist/web/foundations/kbd.d.ts`): `.mh-kbd`: a keyboard shortcut. One `<kbd>` holds a `.mh-kbd__key` `<kbd>` per key (the HTML way to mark up a key combination) with `.mh-kbd__sep` between them: "+" for a chord, "then" for a sequence. A symbol cap (arrows) carries its spoken name as visually hidden text.

```ts
export function createKbd(options: KbdOptions): KbdHandle;

export interface KbdOptions {
  /** One key (`'Esc'`), a chord as a string (`'Ctrl+K'`, `'Ctrl++'`) or as a list (`['Ctrl', 'Shift', 'P']`). */
  keys: string | readonly string[];
  /** The keys are pressed one after another (`G then H`) rather than together. */
  sequence?: boolean;
  /** Word between the keys of a sequence; default "then". */
  thenLabel?: string;
  /** `small` sits inside running text; `medium` (default) stands alone, e.g. in a shortcut list. */
  size?: KbdSize;
}

export interface KbdHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setKeys(keys: string | readonly string[]): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createKbd } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const shortcuts: { action: string; keys: string | string[]; sequence?: boolean }[] = [
  { action: 'Search', keys: 'Ctrl+K' },
  { action: 'Close a dialog', keys: 'Esc' },
  { action: 'Go home', keys: ['G', 'H'], sequence: true },
];

const list = document.createElement('dl');
for (const { action, keys, sequence } of shortcuts) {
  const term = document.createElement('dt');
  const detail = document.createElement('dd');
  term.textContent = action;
  detail.append(createKbd({ keys, sequence }).el);
  list.append(term, detail);
}

const hint = document.createElement('p');
hint.append('Press ', createKbd({ keys: '/', size: 'small' }).el, ' to search.');

document.body.append(list, hint);
```

export function Kbd({ keys, sequence, thenLabel, size, className }: KbdProps);

  thenLabel?: string;

## React example

```tsx
import { Kbd } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const shortcuts: { action: string; keys: string | string[]; sequence?: boolean }[] = [
  { action: 'Search', keys: 'Ctrl+K' },
  { action: 'Close a dialog', keys: 'Esc' },
  { action: 'Go home', keys: ['G', 'H'], sequence: true },
];

export function KbdExample() {
  return (
    <>
      <dl>
        {shortcuts.map(({ action, keys, sequence }) => (
          <div key={action}>
            <dt>{action}</dt>
            <dd>
              <Kbd keys={keys} sequence={sequence} />
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <p>
        Press <Kbd keys="/" size="small" /> to search.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
```
